ModMetaData.name: Colony Manager Redux
ModMetaData.author: ilyvion, Fluffy
ModMetaData.description: Assign tedious managerial tasks to your colonists instead of doing them by hand: set a target for a resource and a colonist with the manager work type keeps it stocked automatically. Includes manager jobs for hunting, forestry, forestry clearing, livestock, foraging, resource gathering, power, and production, plus job templates, import/export, activity logs, history graphs, and gravship support. A spiritual successor to Fluffy's Colony Manager.
